description: Brand Protection Monitor. Finds lookalike domains of a brand (typos, IDN homoglyphs, TLD swaps, added words like -airdrop), checks which exist, and reads their registry (RDAP), TLS certificate and homepage. Each finding has a deterministic 0-100 risk score with plain reasons and an evidence record with fetch times and SHA-256 hashes. POST /v1/brand/scan (official_domains[], brand?, keywords[]?, since?, limit?): the watched report; an unwatched brand gets a quick DNS-only scan now and a full scan next collector cycle. POST /v1/brand/lookalikes (domain): lookalikes that exist now. POST /v1/brand/evidence (evidence_id): the evidence behind one finding. GET /v1/brand/watched: brands under watch. POST /v1/brand/photo (image_url, or sha256 with address or tx_hash): was this exact photo signed (C2PA) and anchored on-chain (Nodle ContentSign, ZKsync Era), by which address, or is it an altered copy; never returns coordinates. Every response is a JSON object. Detection and evidence only; no takedowns.

rpc_types.backend_hint: brand-protection HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/brand/scan, /v1/brand/lookalikes, /v1/brand/evidence, /v1/brand/photo and GET /v1/brand/watched, /v1/version, /v1/health are expected. Every response is a JSON object; bad input returns 4xx with a JSON error object, never HTML or plain text.

specs.notes: Covers all routes in one document.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (no dependencies) behind a RelayMiner, REST at http://<container>:8080. Reports come from a store filled by the operator's collector. Needs outbound DNS (quick scans) and HTTPS (/v1/brand/photo: the photo URL, a ZKsync Era archive RPC, public IPFS gateways).

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service.
Functional probe: reads the store without making any outbound call.

serving.notes: Bodies capped at 1 MiB; responses a few KB to ~100 KB. A quick scan takes up to ~9 s, a photo check 1-8 s (photos up to 16 MB); keep the relay timeout at 30 s or more. Gateways: type passthrough, rpc_types ["rest"].
